text.content:
A strongroom that's kept its contents safe through sheer inconvenience of access rather than any particular vigilance - the ward scratched into its doorway is old, but still humming.

GM Notes

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone not already marked as an ally (DC 14 to detect and counter) - the same alarm-and-shock trap seen at Room 8 and the Boss Arena.
